title: Machine-Checked Formal Verification of BKM Blow-Up Exclusion and Navier-Stokes Regularity Interface in Lean 4
description: This repository provides a modular, machine-checked Lean 4 package implementing the Beale-Kato-Majda (BKM) blow-up exclusion pipeline for the 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes equations under Mathlib 4 (v4.35.0). It verifies real-calculus integrating factor steps, differential-to-exponential Gronwall bounds, and constructive existence of enstrophy bounds, proving that finite-time blowup is logically contradictory under bounded stretching rates.
